summary: SAL posted record Q3 revenue of SAR 579M (up 38% YoY) and net profit of SAR 232M (up 28%), with EBIT margin improving to 43.5%.
Shares rose 4.16% to $160.1 despite missing revenue estimate by $4M, as investors focused on margin expansion and strong cash generation.
Company downgraded 2026 volume outlook to flat-to-slightly negative from mid-single-digit growth due to regional geopolitical uncertainty.
SAL maintained SAR 5.2B capex plan through 2030, with Malham Logistics Park phase one on track for 2027 completion and 2028 revenue start.
Cargo volumes grew 18% to 278M kg driven by import strength and better mix; logistics division grew 53% but remained unprofitable in the quarter.
